'''Mutotech Labs''' was a laboratory located in the [[Duros Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Hunt for the Eagle]] in [[3643 BBY]] an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Cipher Nine]] assaulted the place, killing the guards and obtaining a sample of [[Cyclone]] stimulant used by the soldiers of the [[Eagle's network]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mutotech Labs appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
